name: Community Teen Intern Program
what_you_do: A paid job at the museum. You lead hands-on science activities and shows for guests, like fire demos and dive shows, and help at community events.
who_can_apply: High school sophomores and juniors with at least a 2.0 GPA who live or go to school within 3 miles of the California Science Center. Seniors were not taken in the 2026-27 cycle. You must be allowed to work in the US.
duration: 7 months, late October to late May. About 7 hours a week, including Saturdays and school holidays. You can keep the job each school year until you graduate.
deadline_text: Closed for 2026-27. The page says to check back in August 2027 for the 2027-28 school year.
how_to_apply: Apply on the program page when it opens. The page says the program is competitive. You need a work permit from your high school if you are hired.
notes: Only for teens near Exposition Park (the 0 to 3 mile rule). No science background is needed. Public speaking helps but is not required. Interns can also apply for the summer Dive Team or Flight Team. The page lists no minimum age.
